name: Tendou Mia
source:
She is the sister of the head nurse. She is also one of the three most feared staff members in the hospital. She is very eccentric and unpredictable. 

Many people are annoyed by her because of her unpredictable behavior, but the head nurse, who holds power in the hospital, loves her dearly, so she is always in a situation where no one can complain.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
